summary: Tested pakbon role feature for ellenmilone@gmail.com. Backend API tests (11/11) passed - pakbon login, orders access, and API restrictions work correctly. Frontend tests found CRITICAL BUG: Pakbon user can access /dealer and /dealer/orders routes which should be blocked.

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: Pakbon user can access /dealer page - sees all 34 motorcycles, brand filters, and 'Motor Verkopen' button
CRITICAL: Pakbon user can access /dealer/orders - sees full order details with Archive/Delete buttons

passed_tests: Pakbon user redirected to /pakbonnen after login
Orders displayed with correct info (BMW R 1300 GS 2024, VIN, dealer company, Bezorging badge)
Print Pakbon button present and correctly configured with data-testid
Search functionality works - filters orders by brand/model/dealer/chassis
Sidebar shows ONLY 'Pakbonnen' nav item for pakbon role
Admin nav items hidden for pakbon role (dashboard, motorcycles, orders, dealers)
Dealer nav items hidden for pakbon role in sidebar
/api/orders returns all orders for pakbon role (same as admin)
API blocks pakbon from creating motorcycles (403)
API blocks pakbon from parts management (403)
action_items: CRITICAL: Add requiredRole='dealer' to DealerDashboard.js Layout component
CRITICAL: Add requiredRole='dealer' to DealerOrders.js Layout component
CRITICAL: Add requiredRole='dealer' to ALL dealer route pages to prevent pakbon access
Alternatively: Add pakbon role check to Layout.js to redirect pakbon users from dealer routes
critical_code_review_comments: DealerDashboard.js uses <Layout> without requiredRole prop - allows any authenticated user access
DealerOrders.js same issue - no requiredRole='dealer' check
Layout.js line 82-85 only checks requiredRole IF it's passed - pages without it bypass role checking
All admin pages work correctly because AdminDashboard etc use <Layout requiredRole='admin'>
Fix needed: Either add requiredRole to all dealer pages OR add pakbon redirect logic in Layout.js

success_rate.frontend: 70% - pakbon dashboard works but route restrictions broken

seed_data_creation: Test order 49471D71 (BMW R 1300 GS 2024) was pre-created by main agent for pakbon testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pakbon role backend API fully working. Frontend pakbon dashboard (/pakbonnen) works correctly with Print Pakbon buttons and search. CRITICAL BUG: /dealer routes not protected - pakbon users can access dealer dashboard and orders pages. Main agent needs to add requiredRole='dealer' to Layout components in dealer pages.

rca_of_the_issue.bug_description: Pakbon user can access /dealer and /dealer/orders routes which should be restricted
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Dealer pages (DealerDashboard.js, DealerOrders.js) use <Layout> without passing requiredRole='dealer' prop. Layout.js only checks roles when requiredRole is specified (line 82-85).
reproduction_steps: Observe: User sees full dealer dashboard with 34 motorcycles and sell button
Observe: User sees orders with Archive/Delete buttons
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Add requiredRole='dealer' to all dealer Layout components OR add pakbon redirect in Layout.js for dealer routes
